facts.text: I am struggling to put together an effective teaching team for 2nd grade at my elementary school.
I want to identify the best way to make a difficult decision about my 2nd grade teaching team.
I have four teachers I would like in the group.
The key subjects for the team are reading comprehension and mathematics.
There are currently three teachers in 2nd grade.
One 2nd grade teacher has 11 years of experience and is looking for leadership responsibility.
One 2nd grade teacher is in her 2nd year and moved to 2nd grade from 3rd grade.
The 2nd grade teacher who moved from 3rd grade used to be a reading interventionalist in another district.
One transfer teacher in 2nd grade has not started yet.
The transfer teacher has been teaching for 5 years.
I want this to be my highest performing team in the school.
I am able to hire one new 2nd grade teacher.
I want team building resources I can suggest to the team to read together and then do an exercise with me leading it.
I want a job description for a 2nd grade teacher designed to find a candidate with the traits I described.
